Detailed Description

Builder/parser for the WSC M8 attribute list carried inside an IEEE 1905.1 WSC TLV.

Purpose:

  • Create mode (parse==false): serializes a complete M8 message from m8::config into the provided buffer (adds mandatory WSC attributes and Encrypted Settings). The class is finalized in network byte order.
  • Parse mode (parse==true): validates and exposes fields of an incoming M8.

Notes

  • This class does not encrypt ConfigData. Provide cfg.iv and cfg.encrypted_settings (produced by the KeyWrap stage) before calling create().
